observations.behavior: Adds server+URI keying and metadata precedence, and server-scoped eviction, to the desktop MCP app resource cache and pending-fetch tracking.
observations.posthog_connection: Desktop MCP app service caches resources and pending fetches; this hunk changes the cache and pending-fetch lookups to use a composite key, supporting multiple servers sharing the same URI without collision.

observations.behavior: Adds metadata precedence and server-scoped eviction, and server-scoped eviction, to the desktop MCP app resource cache and pending-fetch tracking.
observations.posthog_connection: Desktop MCP app service; this hunk uses the server-scoped key for metadata and resource caching, and also establishes precedence for metadata supplied by the read response over the listing, while retaining fallback. It also uses the server-scoped key for eviction.

observations.behavior: Adds metadata and server-scoped eviction, and server-scoped eviction, to the desktop MCP app resource cache and pending-fetch tracking.
observations.posthog_connection: Desktop MCP app service; this hunk replaces URI-only eviction with server-scoped eviction, removing cached resources and associations for a disconnected server while preserving other servers' cached resources.
